speaker: Ms Gho Sze Kee
text: asked the Minister for Manpower in view of the growing uncertainty in the jobs market and the challenges faced by recent tertiary graduates, whether there are plans to review and recalibrate the foreign manpower mix to provide Singapore’s local workforce with better opportunities, particularly at entry and mid-level PMET positions.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: The updates are done annually and with key changes announced at MOM’s Committee of Supply.
We strike a very careful balance when reviewing these policies.
We need to provide businesses sufficient access to talent so that we can continue to maintain Singapore’s global competitiveness.
In particular, foreign professionals help to attract foreign investments and multinational corporations that create a large number of good jobs for Singaporeans.
Foreign firms also create business for local firms, who in turn create jobs for Singaporeans.
